title: PollJob
description: One request for a provider to serve: the 200 body of `GET /relay/v1/poll` (node token). The master long-polls for POLL_WINDOW_SECONDS and answers 204 with an EMPTY body when no work came, so a client's own timeout must be longer. A poll never wakes a sleeping grid. Readers ignore keys they do not know.

endpoint_path.description: Where to send `body` on the engine: `chat/completions`, `completions`, `responses`, or a `media/` path while media is served.

inference_timeout_seconds.description: What is left of the request's budget.

wire_format.description: The dialect `body` is in. An older provider ignores it.

provider_attempt_token.description: Only for a provider whose capability entry sets `provider_attempt_tokens`; echoed in `X-Grid-Provider-Attempt` on the result.
